dashboard.label: TA-cronbeat Overview
dashboard.description: Collects scheduled-job heartbeat data: all systemd timers (next elapsed, last elapsed, last-run timestamps) via systemctl list-timers, plus a count of cron jobs from /etc/crontab

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-cronbeat requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-cronbeat", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-cronbeat/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("cronbeat.timers_total") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("cronbeat.cron_jobs") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="cronbeat:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | spath input=_raw output=n path=timers_stale | stats sum(n) as value
index=main sourcetype="cronbeat:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=stale_timers{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "unit" | table host "unit"
